name: heymark
description: Plan, schedule and review social media content for your brands, and triage your inbox and comments, with your HeyMark data.

interface.longDescription:
HeyMark is the workspace where community managers, agencies and creators run the social media of one or many brands. Connect your HeyMark account to plan a week of content from your brand profile and past results, turn ideas and drafts into scheduled publications, triage unread messages and comments with replies in your brand voice, and review how your posts perform.

HeyMark only reads and changes the brands your account can access. Public actions such as replying to a comment or a direct message, publishing, or deleting always show a preview and wait for your approval. Scheduling and publishing need a connected social account.
defaultPrompt: Plan next week's content for my brand.
Which messages and comments need a reply today?
How did my posts perform last month?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: weekly content plan, inbox and comment triage, performance review, and backlog to scheduled publications.

es-ES.subtitle: Redes sociales de tus marcas
es-ES.description:
HeyMark es el espacio donde community managers, agencias y creadores gestionan las redes sociales de una o varias marcas. Conecta tu cuenta de HeyMark para planificar una semana de contenido a partir del perfil de tu marca y sus resultados, convertir ideas y borradores en publicaciones programadas, revisar mensajes y comentarios sin leer con respuestas en la voz de tu marca, y analizar el rendimiento de tus publicaciones.

HeyMark solo lee y modifica las marcas a las que tu cuenta tiene acceso. Las acciones públicas, como responder un comentario o un mensaje directo, publicar o eliminar, siempre muestran una vista previa y esperan tu aprobación. Para programar y publicar necesitas una cuenta social conectada.
